lines.cap: Death came for Grandma. She made him tea.
lines.say: Death came for Grandma. She made him tea.

lines.cap: Eleven p.m. A knock at the door.
lines.say: Eleven p.m. A knock at the door.

lines.cap: Good evening, madam. I'm afraid it's time.
lines.say: Good evening, madam. I'm afraid it's time.

lines.cap: Time for tea? Come in, come in. You're so thin!
lines.say: Time for tea? Come in, come in. You're so thin!
lines.bubble: TEA? COME IN! YOU'RE SO THIN! 🫖

lines.cap: Oh. Is that tea? Well. Perhaps one cup.
lines.say: Oh. Is that tea? Well. Perhaps one cup.

lines.cap: One cup became three. Then dinner.
lines.say: One cup became three. Then dinner.

lines.cap: Eat, beta. Who feeds you? Nobody feeds you.
lines.say: Eat, beta. Who feeds you? Nobody feeds you.

lines.cap: Nobody has called me beta in four thousand years.
lines.say: Nobody has called me beta in four thousand years.

lines.cap: Nani, I knitted you a scarf.
lines.say: Nani, I knitted you a scarf.

lines.cap: He still hasn't done his job. I've been waiting since 1824.
lines.say: He still hasn't done his job. I've been waiting since 1824.

lines.cap: Death still visits every Sunday. Grandma is ninety nine.
lines.say: Death still visits every Sunday. Grandma is ninety nine.

lines.cap: Tag the grandma who could beat Death. Death came for Grandma. She made him tea.
lines.say: Tag the grandma who could beat Death. Death came for Grandma. She made him tea.
